description:
# **promptwaves**
**an online 24-hour hackathon sprint.**

No pre-released problem statements. No days spent preparing for a challenge you already know. Just one announcement, 24 hours on the clock, and a whole lot of building.

Welcome to **promptwaves**, a 24-hour hackathon where the challenge is kept under wraps until the very last moment. When the clock starts, the problem statement drops, teams get to work, and the race to build something brilliant begins.

**Join our Whatsapp group:**
[https://chat.whatsapp.com/BqXF7SpUlki1yiSC1glpP3](https://chat.whatsapp.com/BqXF7SpUlki1yiSC1glpP3)

# **The Stakes Are Real:**
We're putting **₹40,000 in cash prizes** up for grabs, along with free domain names and a bunch of additional in-kind rewards.

Not just bragging rights. Something worth building for:

-> ₹40,000 in cash prizes
-> Free domain names
-> Additional goodies and in-kind rewards

# **Who's This For?**
Developers, designers, students, AI enthusiasts, makers, and anyone who enjoys turning ideas into actual products.

You don't need to have everything figured out before you arrive. You need curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and the drive to make something happen.

**jsmyn.labs**
